sources.snippet: Chest X-Ray Pneumonia Classification Using CNN (TensorFlow) This project uses a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to classify Chest X-Ray images as Normal or Pneumonia. The model was trained in Google Colab using TensorFlow 2.19.0 and TPU/GPU acceleration.
